attributes.additional_details: Kier Starmer and the Labour Party plot to cull up to 90% of the Dartmoor ponies for land. As animals do not have a voice, it is our duty to protect wildlife.
attributes.background: Kier Starmer and the Labour Party should not get away with their plot to cull the Dartmoor ponies.
